agents.description: Exactly 12 independent seats. Each seat should carry p_up, evidence, evidence_as_of, uncertainty and invalidation. Missing evidence is NO_READ/neutral.

challenger.description: Must audit stale-vs-fresh conflicts, period mismatches, duplicated narratives, implausible targets and weak/illiquid evidence.

final.description: Final Judge after conflict resolution; p_up, expected_return and forecast_range remain distinct.
